memory_candidates.content: verify-deploy.sh's doc-lint (gate 3) and manifest-driven verify.lua (gate 5) checks compare the deployed .claude/ tree against agent-system/extensions/ source content, so ANY uncommitted or un-redeployed source-store edit -- whether from this task's own in-flight work or a concurrently-dispatched sibling task on a shared tree -- trips 'content differs from source' / 'missing scripts' findings that look like regressions but are deploy-tree staleness, not defects. Before treating a verify-deploy.sh FAIL as a regression, check whether the named path is (a) one of this task's own recently-edited files with no redeploy phase planned (expected, if the task's own Non-Goals bar redeploying), or (b) inside a concurrent sibling's declared file_scope (check git log for their commits). Neither case is 'fix the gate' or 'fix the foreign file' -- it is 'attribute and record as a Reasoned Exclusion', confirmed by git log/git status evidence per finding.
